Allow microphone access to use voice input. You can enable it in the phone’s app settings.

In Typeless Settings → Audio → Microphone, select Auto-detect. ClipRelay switches to phone audio while recording and restores your computer microphone afterward.

Enable Steam Streaming Microphone or install VB-CABLE on your computer to receive phone audio. ClipRelay selects the virtual microphone automatically.
